L105: 【37†M Countdown】 Chart winners (2026)
L106: ---
L107: The M Countdown Chart is a 【38†record chart】 on the South Korean 【39†Mnet】 【40†television music program】 【37†M Countdown】. Every week, the show awards the best-performing 【41†single】 on the chart in the country during its live broadcast. Since March 12, 2026, the show has been hosted by 【42†Park Gun-wook】, 【43†So Jung-hwan】 and 【44†Kye-hoon】.^{【45†[1]】}
